title: Context Drift Signal
description: An observation an executing agent makes about context it was given in a context envelope. A signal reports what the agent noticed; it never carries a replacement value. Correcting context is ALVIRA's job through elicitation and the human's job through confirmation, so this contract deliberately provides no field in which an agent could supply new context. That absence is the point: it keeps machine-inferred content out of confirmed context, which is what distinguishes ALVIRA from ambient capture. See policies/HANDOFF_POLICY.md.

envelope_id.description: The context envelope this context was delivered in.

reference.description: The specific context item, matching one entry in the envelope's references array. A signal about the envelope as a whole is not actionable, so this is required.

signal_type.description: contradicted: the work produced evidence that conflicts with this context. stale: the context appears to describe a state that has since changed. missing: the work needed context of a kind the envelope did not carry. ambiguous: the context admits more than one reading and the agent had to guess. unused: the context was delivered but never needed, which over time indicates the envelope is over-broad.

observation.description: What the agent actually saw, stated as fact rather than as a recommendation. 'Deploy was rejected twice for spend over 500' rather than 'the spend limit should be raised'.

evidence.description: Optional pointers a human can check: run ids, artifact paths, log locations, timestamps.

confidence.description: How strongly the agent holds this observation. Low-confidence signals are still worth emitting; ALVIRA decides what is worth asking about.

occurrences.description: How many times this was observed within the work item. Repetition is the main reason a signal earns a question.

proposed_question.description: Optional. A question ALVIRA could put to the user. A question, never an answer. ALVIRA is free to rewrite or discard it.
